activity.notes: ATLAS uses 425 BCE as a representative Athenian dramatic-activity year for Aristophanes, when The Acharnians was produced at the Lenaea in Athens. The single-year milestone avoids inventing a continuous career boundary from incomplete ancient evidence.

sources.title: Dicaeopolis' Motivations in Aristophanes' Acharnians — Journal of Hellenic Studies
sources.citation_text: The Journal of Hellenic Studies article identifies The Acharnians as Aristophanes' play performed at the Lenaea in 425 BCE and discusses its Athenian setting.
